description: Central Province - Empowered the Municipal Councils in the Central Province to accept By-laws relating to Regulating, Supervising and Controlling Disaster Management
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of new by-laws relating to disaster management for municipal councils in the Central Province. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks, procedures, and compliance requirements for disaster management, including the composition and functions of a Disaster Management Committee. The content focuses on creating legal provisions and regulatory structures rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
